ai_summary: ACC Limited's Q2 2026 standalone financial results reveal a significant year-over-year decline in Profit After Tax by 61.5% to ₹148 crore, coupled with reduced revenue, indicating a material negative impact on profitability and raising a red flag regarding operational performance. The board simultaneously approved the strategic acquisition of a 26% equity stake in Amplus Andhra Power for captive renewable energy sourcing, while also providing an update on the ongoing Ambuja Cements merger's regulatory approvals.
